## PR Description

## What

Fixes #2273. Two event-side changes in `_AutoCompactorCliHooks` (lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart — no compaction-internals touched):

1. **Bracket closes on RUN end.** `onDone` no longer gates `compactionEnd` on `_runTokensBefore` (set only inside `onPass`). A zero-pass run — e.g. the cap-unknown E1 channel: the post-run fold consumes the armed one-shot pass with `force=false` over an under-trigger transcript, the structured engine takes the `:338` under-trigger short-circuit and fires only `hooks.onDone(0, …)` — now emits `compaction_end` with `tokens_freed: 0`. Previously the open `compaction_start` attributed the following turn's supervisor time to compaction.
2. **The pass counter counts receipts, not runs.** `_compactionPassesStarted++` moved from `_runAutoCompact` (every run, pass or not) into `onPass` (per pass receipt). A zero-pass run leaves it at its pre-run value, so the funnel's `passesRan > 0` trim gate (`_maybeOverWindowContinue`) never reads non-runs as passes. Added `compactionPassesStartedForTest` (`@visibleForTesting`, mirroring the existing seam convention) so tests can pin it.

- **RED** (fix reverted): zero-pass run emitted `compaction_start` with NO `compaction_end` — the leak, reproduced end to end via the cap-unknown refusal → heal retry → post-run fold chain.
- **GREEN**: `compaction_end` emitted exactly once per `compaction_start` with `tokens_freed: 0`, counter `0`; pass-carrying run keeps balanced brackets, `tokens_freed ≥ 0`, counter ≥ 1. File 8/8 green — REG byte-shapes (incl. the pre-existing compaction-frames test and `hep_test.dart` goldens) untouched.
- Compaction-event batches green: `auto_compactor_test` + `auto_compactor_structured_budget_test` (28), `message_cap_heal` + `over_window_continuation_retry` (11), `checkpoint_restore_budget` + `windowed_resume` + `resume_boot_cap` (8), `submit_cancel_compaction` + `compaction_report` (27).
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format` exact.

`docs/hep.md` already documents the frames as "bracketed like a run" — the fix makes zero-pass runs honor the documented contract; no frame bytes change.

## Notes for review

- The freed-delta path for pass-carrying runs is byte-identical (same `before − tokens`, same clamp); only the zero-pass case gained a frame.
- Failed passes still count toward the counter (their receipt fired) — the trim gate's "LM passes failed → trim locally" semantics stay intact; cancelled-before-receipt runs no longer inflate it.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

# pr-2307: fix(2273): zero-pass compaction runs close their HEP bracket and don't count as passes

## Description

## What

Fixes #2273. Two event-side changes in `_AutoCompactorCliHooks` (lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart — no compaction-internals touched):

1. **Bracket closes on RUN end.** `onDone` no longer gates `compactionEnd` on `_runTokensBefore` (set only inside `onPass`). A zero-pass run — e.g. the cap-unknown E1 channel: the post-run fold consumes the armed one-shot pass with `force=false` over an under-trigger transcript, the structured engine takes the `:338` under-trigger short-circuit and fires only `hooks.onDone(0, …)` — now emits `compaction_end` with `tokens_freed: 0`. Previously the open `compaction_start` attributed the following turn's supervisor time to compaction.
2. **The pass counter counts receipts, not runs.** `_compactionPassesStarted++` moved from `_runAutoCompact` (every run, pass or not) into `onPass` (per pass receipt). A zero-pass run leaves it at its pre-run value, so the funnel's `passesRan > 0` trim gate (`_maybeOverWindowContinue`) never reads non-runs as passes. Added `compactionPassesStartedForTest` (`@visibleForTesting`, mirroring the existing seam convention) so tests can pin it.

## Verification (targeted dart, standalone SDK in the worktree)

TDD red-first, `test/cli/headless_hep_test.dart`:
- **RED** (fix reverted): zero-pass run emitted `compaction_start` with NO `compaction_end` — the leak, reproduced end to end via the cap-unknown refusal → heal retry → post-run fold chain.
- **GREEN**: `compaction_end` emitted exactly once per `compaction_start` with `tokens_freed: 0`, counter `0`; pass-carrying run keeps balanced brackets, `tokens_freed ≥ 0`, counter ≥ 1. File 8/8 green — REG byte-shapes (incl. the pre-existing compaction-frames test and `hep_test.dart` goldens) untouched.
- Compaction-event batches green: `auto_compactor_test` + `auto_compactor_structured_budget_test` (28), `message_cap_heal` + `over_window_continuation_retry` (11), `checkpoint_restore_budget` + `windowed_resume` + `resume_boot_cap` (8), `submit_cancel_compaction` + `compaction_report` (27).
- `dart analyze` clean on the touched files; `dart format` exact.

`docs/hep.md` already documents the frames as "bracketed like a run" — the fix makes zero-pass runs honor the documented contract; no frame bytes change.

## Notes for review

- The freed-delta path for pass-carrying runs is byte-identical (same `before − tokens`, same clamp); only the zero-pass case gained a frame.
- Failed passes still count toward the counter (their receipt fired) — the trim gate's "LM passes failed → trim locally" semantics stay intact; cancelled-before-receipt runs no longer inflate it.

# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
      # gen-l10n OUTPUT carries no .g.dart suffix, so the generated set
      # above misses it — the comment above always said "app_localizations
      # … excluded, not baselined" and flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml's own
      # loc gate carries the same exclude; the ROOT one was missing the
      # pattern (first fired on issue #2062 chunk 15, the first commit to
      # STAGE the files).
      - '**/l10n/app_localizations*.dart'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}

🪶 **NIT: the comment overstates the invariant — two engine terminal paths still don't fire `onDone`**

"every engine terminal path fires it" is not literally true. Two terminal paths return without firing `onDone`, leaving the `compaction_start` bracket open (same before/after this fix):

- The classic engine's early returns — `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart:380` (`window <= 0`) and the unforced under-trigger short-circuit right below it — fire no `onDone`. Reachable when classic is the primary engine (`compactionEngine: classic`) or via the factory's fall-through (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart:1252`) after a structured not-ok outcome.
- A user cancel mid-compaction: `abort.token.throwIfCancelled()` in the `finally` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:848`) throws past the open bracket.

For the structured engine (the default, and #2273's subject) the claim holds — the factory closes the bracket on every terminal path (ok short-circuit, ok with passes, timeout→trim/fail). Worth a wording tweak ("every structured-engine terminal path…", or noting the classic early-returns) so the next reader doesn't assume universal bracket closure — the two residual leaks above are exactly the class of bug this PR fixes.
